attempts.raw_response: The 62-year-old, from Nottinghamshire, said he trusted Mr Handford after meeting him at shows and events. "It went in as a nice car and has come back worse than when I sent it," he added. Both men are now among a growing number of customers who have accused a classic car restorer of leaving vehicles unfinished and taking money without completing work. When approached for comment, Mr Handford denied any wrongdoing and insisted he had completed restoration work to a high standard. He claimed some customers had changed their specifications during the process, which had caused delays and additional costs. However, he acknowledged that communication could have been better and said he was trying to resolve outstanding issues with clients. Several other car owners have now come forward with similar complaints about incomplete work and missed deadlines.
